title: Rated only filter on the References feed
description: Add a third Show option to the newsroom References feed so an editor can list just the References already rated, to find them again. Labels Unrated / All / Rated (one line at 375 px). Reads only the rated feed partitions a page at a time; no backend change. Best bets = original prediction, Newest = arrival. PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#1079 (feature/references-rated-only). Specs: features/newsroom-reference-feed.feature.
